Its pod detail shows Last State Terminated, Reason Error, Exit Code 137, paired with kubelet events 'Container server failed liveness probe, will be restarted' and 'Warning Unhealthy ... Liveness probe failed: timeout: failed to connect service 172.20.2.221:7001 within 1s: context deadline exceeded'. The container actually serves gRPC on port 7000 (PORT=7000, containerPort 7000, Service targetPort 7000, readinessProbe grpc port 7000 -> READY 1/1), while GetAppYAML shows livenessProbe grpc port 7001, a port with no listener. Active connectivity check confirms currencyservice:7000 open / Connection Succeeded but currencyservice:7001 Connection failed. Logs show no OOM or crash (only 'Profiler disabled.'), and exit reason is Error, not OOMKilled, excluding memory pressure: kubelet kills and restarts the container repeatedly solely because the liveness probe targets the wrong port.
